alt: A wild elephant crossing the track in Yala National Park

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Yala at dawn is the single best morning you can have in Sri Lanka. Leopards are shy, but the elephants and peacocks never disappoint.
expert.tip: Wear neutral colours for the safari and keep the camera ready at the waterholes. The first hour after the gates open is when the cats move.

summary: Eight days that do it all: a soft landing in Colombo, two nights in Kandy with Sigiriya and the dance show, a night at Yala with a dawn jeep safari, two on the beach at Bentota with Mirissa and Galle, and a final night in the capital.
included: Included: 7 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast and dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show; a full day excursion to Sigiriya; private half day Kandy sightseeing; a jeep safari in Yala National Park with park ticket; a private excursion to Mirissa and Galle; full day Colombo sightseeing; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
